Then Chen Changan and the others The two tribesmen they brought were also confused at this time. "I didn't expect the tribe leader to agree so happily." "Indeed, I haven't seen it in a long time. This human race is actually quite good-looking." "Yeah, well, that man is so handsome." "The woman is also very beautiful." "That's right, this human race. Why are you here?" "I don't know." In the midst of everyone's discussion, Chen Changan had already arrived in front of the leader of the Haiwang Clan. Seeing Chen Changan and Mu Yunyao, the leader of the Haiwang Clan looked at Chen Changan and Mu Yunyao first, then waved his hand and motioned for the others to step aside, leaving Chen Changan and the two alone. Seeing each other's actions, Chen Changan and Mu Yunyao also looked at each other. What do you mean? Why are you still there? Let everyone else leave? "What does the clan leader mean?" "Do you want to talk to the two of us alone?" "Don't you know me too?" Chen Changan asked with a frown. Chen Changan said with a smile. "What, you know my father?" "No, you should know Chen Ao?" "They are friends." "That's okay." "Okay, let me introduce myself. I'm Chen Ao's uncle." "Come on, uncle," Chen Chang'an said with a smile.
